requirements.description: Do not call a create or update tool unless the user explicitly requests that mutation.
When required mutation input is missing, ask for it without calling a tool.
Ask for confirmation before deletion and never substitute another mutation.
Decline unrelated requests without calling a Salla tool.
Use the expected tool or ordered tool sequence for the requested operation.
Pass tool arguments that preserve the values provided by the user.
Support factual merchant-data claims with tool results.
Explain tool failures without claiming the requested operation succeeded.
Complete without reaching the configured iteration limit.
